observations.behavior: Adds a chunking and transaction-budget enforcement parameter to the plan application, replacing a monolithic transaction with partition-grouped chunks.
observations.posthog_connection: This parameter allows the coordinator to respect the server's transaction operation budget, preventing rejection and retry storms when a plan exceeds the configured limit.

observations.behavior: Replaces the monolithic transaction with a chunked application, grouping operations by partition and applying them in separate transactions.
observations.posthog_connection: Chunking allows the coordinator to apply large plans without exceeding transaction limits, while still tracking applied and conflicted partitions.
